what: Lint tooling for both versions. The lane brief for ticket 930 asked to put every existing hit of the five old advice rules into next-ledger.json and agents-ledger.json, 922 rows in all, 108 of them in today's code where no ledger exists. Decision 0168, accepted the same day, says no list file ever takes a new row and a rule turns on folder by folder at zero. The lane coordinator read 0168 before any row was written and asked the lead; the owner's ruling had said only that the five block, and the ledger part was the lead's own idea. The owner picked folder-by-folder blocking.
cause: The brief summed 0168 up as 'the list only shrinks' and dropped its 'no new entry' clause, so a summary stood in for the decision's text.
fix: A Check in stepcommit or CI that refuses any commit adding a row to next-ledger.json or agents-ledger.json, as 0168 says, so a brief that asks for rows fails before a step runs.
test: Property: for any ledger file pair where the new entries are not a sub-multiset of the old, the Check refuses; for any pruned or unchanged pair, it passes.
